page_title: TouchGrassBar — Codex & Claude Usage in Your Menu Bar

summary.name: TouchGrassBar
summary.one_liner: A macOS menu bar app that shows your Codex and Claude usage limits and token totals, with an optional friends leaderboard.
use_cases: Monitor Codex and Claude 5-hour usage limits from the Mac menu bar
See how many tokens you have used and their approximate API-equivalent cost
Compare token usage with friends on a leaderboard
Track AI coding tool usage without leaving your current window
summary.what_it_does: The page describes a menu bar app for macOS that displays Codex and Claude usage limits, including 5-hour limit percentages and reset times. It shows token totals and an approximate API-equivalent dollar cost. Codex and Claude are detected locally on the Mac. Users can add friends and compare token usage on a leaderboard, and the page states that prompts stay private and provider data stays on the Mac. The app is installed by dragging it to Applications and then opened from the menu bar.
notable: Detects Codex and Claude usage locally on the Mac
Friends leaderboard for comparing token usage while keeping prompts private
Shows 5-hour limit percentages with reset times and API-equivalent cost
caveats: Platform support appears limited to macOS
Pricing is not stated on the page
